=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:480-571 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_verify_one`, when the runs list is cut off and `page_oldest` is more than one day after the merge, the second read only ever covers the fixed window `merged_at..merged_at+1d`; if that day has no decisive run, the script logs `outcome=pending reason=window_undecided` and nothing on a later tick moves the window.
  WHY: Every hourly tick repeats the same query on the same closed one-day window, so a decisive run between day 1 and `page_oldest` is never examined and the heal stays pending until it leaves the 7-day window. This state is missing from the "Known limits" in agents.d/heal-verify.md, and the test only checks the first tick. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:570 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `window_undecided` log line `log "outcome=pending issue=${number} reason=window_undecided"` leaves out `window_end`.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell from the log that the pending state is repeating on the same closed window. Rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion, not as a finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Budget: 1 list query per tick, then at most 3 reads per heal." (Scope item 2: compare "at most 2 per heal" within that budget; the P7 plan also says at most 3 reads per checked heal)
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh `_verify_one` cut-off runs-list path (line 481 `read_limit=$((MAX_READS_PER_HEAL + 1))`, used at lines 484 and 527) and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py `test_truncated_list_descendant_failure_gets_compare_and_jobs_reads`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Line 481 raises the limit to 4 REST reads on the cut-off path (page runs + window runs + compare + jobs), tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:432-439 asserts `reads=4`, changelog.d/heal-verify.md:11 documents "4 when a heal's runs list is cut off at 100 runs", agents.d/heal-verify.md line 2 and script header lines 475-476 also document it, the linked issue #8583 / PR description / plan grant #8434 name no such exception, and the previous revision stayed within 3 reads by parking a descendant failure as `reason=read_budget`. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT with confidence 3 because it could not see the issue body.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:`_verify_one`, lines 482-494 and lines 568-571 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the runs list is cut off and `page_oldest` is more than one day after the merge, the window read always covers only `created=<mergedAt>..<mergedAt+1d>`; with no decisive run that day, the heal is pending `window_undecided` and no later tick moves the window.
  WHY: Each tick uses 2 reads and gets the same empty answer until the heal leaves the 7-day window, so a decisive run between day 1 and `page_oldest` is never examined. agents.d/heal-verify.md calls this "pending, retried next tick", and the test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py line 448 only checks one tick. Suggested fix: set `window_end="${page_oldest}"` and `window_only=false` with no one-day cap, or list the state in "Known limits". This existed before under the reason `no_completed_run`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Budget: 1 list query per tick, then at most 3 reads per heal." (Scope item 2: compare "at most 2 per heal")
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh `_verify_one` (line 481 `read_limit=$((MAX_READS_PER_HEAL + 1))`, used at lines 484 and 527); tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py `test_truncated_list_descendant_failure_gets_compare_and_jobs_reads` (line 438 asserts `reads=4`)
  Evidence of absence: The last autofix run raised the limit to 4 reads on the cut-off path. The test asserts `reads=4`, changelog.d/heal-verify.md documents the exception, and neither the issue nor the plan allows it. Fix: either stay within 3 reads by parking the run as `read_budget`, or record the budget change on #8583 and its plan.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh line 570, `window_undecided` log line: add `window_end=${window_end}` and update the `WORKFLOW_HEAL_VERIFY` log-format bullet in agents.d/heal-verify.md (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh line 484, `[ $((reads + 1)) -gt "${read_limit}" ]`: this check can never be true (`reads`=1, `read_limit`=4); remove it or add a comment (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: Later ticks re-query the same one-day window, so the heal stays pending until it leaves the 7-day window and decisive runs outside that day are never checked.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:`_verify_one`, the `window_only=true` branch around lines 480-494 and the post-loop check at lines 568-571 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On a cut-off list with `page_oldest > merged_at + 1 day`, the run loop only processes `window_file` (the one-day slice), and the page data already read is discarded; with no decisive run that day, the result is `window_undecided` and the window never moves.
  WHY: A heal with more than 100 post-merge runs and a quiet or cancelled-only first day stays parked until it leaves the 7-day window. `test_truncated_list_undecided_first_day_waits` only covers the first tick, and the "Known limits" in `agents.d/heal-verify.md` do not list `window_undecided`.

  Expected change site: `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh` `_verify_one` cut-off path (`read_limit=$((MAX_READS_PER_HEAL + 1))`, the `runs_<n>_window.json` read, the `read_limit` check in the run loop) and `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py::test_truncated_list_descendant_failure_gets_compare_and_jobs_reads`
  Evidence of absence: 4 REST reads on the cut-off path. `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:432-439` asserts `reads=4`, and `changelog.d/heal-verify.md` documents the exception. The issue, PR description and plan grant `#8434` name no exception. The previous revision stayed within 3 by parking as `reason=read_budget`, and the change was made inside the autofix loop.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  WHY: Each hourly tick repeats the same first-day query, so a decisive run between that day and the oldest run on the page is never considered and the heal stays unverified until it leaves the seven-day window.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:lines 482-494 (`window_end` cap), 506-513 (`window_only=true` → `select_file = window_file`), 568-571 (`window_undecided` pending) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The truncated-runs path has a `pending` state it never leaves, and the gap `(day1, page_oldest)` is never covered: `page_oldest` only moves later, and no per-issue state persists (`RUNTIME_DIR` is per-run-id, line 72).
  WHY: The heal is never verified, so the promise in `agents.d/heal-verify.md` line 2 is not met; no wrong verdict is issued, and the state is not in the documented known limits. Triggered by more than 100 runs since the merge (plausible for an hourly scheduled workflow). Fix: persist a per-issue watermark, or query `merged_at..page_oldest` when that holds 100 runs or fewer (the truncation check at lines 502-505 fails open).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:line 570 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `log "outcome=pending issue=${number} reason=window_undecided"` leaves out `window_end`, which is in scope (declared at line 480).
  WHY: Operators cannot see that the pending state repeats on the same closed window. Fix: append `window_end=${window_end}` (1 line).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "at most 3 reads per heal" (wording taken from the gpt-6-luna finding; the reviewer could not check it against the issue body)
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh line 79 (`MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3`), line 481 (`read_limit=$((MAX_READS_PER_HEAL + 1))`); test `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:432-439`
  Evidence of absence: The test asserts `reads=4` on the truncated path. The exception is self-documented in `changelog.d/heal-verify.md:11`, `agents.d/heal-verify.md` line 2 and script header lines 475-476. It is only a gap if the issue body states the limit with no exception. Fix: align the issue/changelog wording, or remove the 4th read and accept `runs_truncated` pending.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
